question:
**Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.**

Shivam is more cleverer than any other boy in the office.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1'****.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error in the sentence is the usage of **"more cleverer."**
 
• The word "cleverer" is already in the comparative form, so using **"more" **with **"cleverer"** is redundant.
 
• The **correct phrase** should be *"Shivam is cleverer"* or *"Shivam is more clever."*
 
• Thus, the error is in the segment** "Shivam is more cleverer."**

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'Shivam is more clever than any other boy in the office'.*
